# Mini-XML provenance

This directory vendors the Mini-XML 4.0.4 source release from
<https://github.com/michaelrsweet/mxml> at commit
`0d5afc4278d7a336d554602b951c2979c3f8f296` (the commit referenced by the
annotated `v4.0.4` tag).

The upstream files are unmodified. `config.h.meson`, `meson.build`, and this
provenance note are local integration files.
